task: Add a per-step tool map (tool to allowed integration aliases) and optional integration_alias on script tool calls, enforced in the workflow scope, with save-time validation and a publish warning.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches handler, authorizer, three scope resolve signatures, WorkflowToolResolver, resolve_workflow_tool, the ToolNode/VirtualAssistantService/AgentWorkspaceToolkit/ScriptToolRegistry plumbing, the WorkflowTool model, validation and router warnings, plus SDK. The step config has no path into the scope today, so a new carrier is needed.

Security-sensitive: a script-supplied alias must never reach the creator's account unless listed. No exact precedent; the closest is ToolNode._owner_user_id and find_setting_for_tool, but the resolver build path lacks an owner id. ProjectScope swallows resolver errors into tool_unavailable, which conflicts with bad_arguments. The AC enumerates many edge cases with no existing parameterized template for them.

About 12-15 source files (SDK, reference md, handler, authorizer, context, workflow_resolution, toolkit, virtual_assistant_service, tool_node, tool_service, workflow_models, validation/resources, router) plus 2 docs and many tests, across several directories.

SDK/protocol, service, workflow model and persistence of the new field, API router warnings, and the settings/credential integration. The persistence format is not verified, and no UI work is in this repository.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk raised: affects authorization of tool calls and the creator's integration credentials
Component Scope raised: touches the shared script tool-call scope contract (callable_tools flips from the whole catalog to a listed set)
